method: plain GETs of fredgraph.csv with the desk's identified user agent (the compare leg's own convention); the archive leg reads db/custom.db strictly read-only via bun:sqlite

DFII10.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis, Inflation-Indexed
DFII10.what_it_is: the 10-year TIPS constant-maturity REAL yield, percent, not seasonally adjusted, daily (business days)
DFII10.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (H.15)

DGS10.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis
DGS10.what_it_is: the 10-year Treasury constant-maturity NOMINAL yield, percent, not seasonally adjusted, daily (business days)
DGS10.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (H.15)

calendar.missing_value_convention: bond-market holidays print as date-only rows (empty value cell, sometimes '.') — dropped by the parser, never stored

grounded_grid_impact.verdict: PASS — the grid keeps ≥ 200 common trading days; no cosd widening needed (FRED history is free back to 2003 if it ever is)
grounded_grid_impact.binding_constraint: the EODHD trailing-year fetch window (FETCH_WINDOW_DAYS = 380) — the FRED bond calendar is wider than the grid in every observed window

registry_entry.note: Real-yield proxy: no TIPS real-yield series on this plan; the 10Y nominal Treasury yield stands in for it.

bug_as_found.mislabel_surface: the gold page dashboard's first indicator card (indicators.realYield) reads Observation.dataset = 'realYield' (the ^TNX nominal closes) under the label 'Real 10y yield' / «بازده واقعی ۱۰ساله»

cron_inventory.plan: Workers Free — 5 cron triggers per account
cron_inventory.consequence: no new cron worker — the FRED sync rides the desk's existing pull-on-render once-per-UTC-day gate (2 small CSV GETs, no key, no quota)
